meta.name: Special prime fields · classical heuristic
meta.regime: p = r^e − s with r and s small; exploitable representation supplied
meta.rules: Special-prime DLP with an essential representation restriction. Here L_X[α,c] = exp((c+o(1))(ln X)^α(ln ln X)^(1−α)); all logarithms in this definition are natural. Only compare entries with this cost scale, input domain and computational model. Polynomial and quasi-polynomial expressions without an extracted scalar are not ranked.
